clubs.description: GAAFFS has access to 11 miles of the River Witham in Lincolnshire along with streches of the R. Welland and R. Chater. Fishing for Grayling and Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Mixed depth run with riffles and glides, suitable for daytime trout and evening grayling sessions.
Slower holding water with undercut banks and deeper winter grayling lies.

clubs.description: CTC has access to c. 5 miles of the River Cam in Cambridgeshire. Fishing for Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Classic chalkstream style glide with weed beds and dry-fly opportunities.
Tree-lined bends with deeper pools and productive nymphing water.

clubs.fullName: Leek and District Fly Fishing Association
clubs.description: LADFFA has access to c. 10 miles of the River Dove in Staffordshire. Fishing for Grayling and Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Fast pocket water with short glides and reliable summer evening rises.
Longer pools and broken runs with strong grayling potential in colder months.
Sample beat used for validating fishing beat configuration and display.
